title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00148 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
02:30 - 02:45: Performed TBT for skidding rig
02:45 - 03:30: Skidded rig aft to well f-5
03:30 - 03:45: Built handrail scaffold in moonpool. Meanwhile performed post-skid checks.
03:45 - 04:15: Removed hatch in moonpool
04:15 - 04:45: Built ring/fence around deck openings. Meanwhile performed TBT to run nt2 connector.
04:45 - 05:30: Pulled master bushing and removed fence around rotary. Ran nt2 connector and installed same on multibowl.
05:30 - 07:00: P/u and m/u cutter BHA
07:00 - 07:30: M/u multibowl RT to inner string. Recorder up/down weight 75/72 ton. RIH and engaged multibowl RT to multibowl by rotating elevator. M/u TDS.
07:30 - 07:45: Performed TBT for removal of tension cylinders
07:45 - 12:00: Bled off pressure on tension cylinders and transfered load to TDS. R/d tension cylinders, hubs and tensioner ring. Removed boat collision stool and centralizers at all decks. Installed hoses to multibowl outlets. Meanwhile l/o 21 joints 5 1/2" DP from set-back. Performed TBT for cutting riser.
12:00 - 12:30: Took tension, 20 ton overpull. Staged up flow rate to 2400 LPM 90 bar. Cut riser, lost overpull, good indication of cut.
12:30 - 13:00: Removed hoses and outlets from multibowl.
13:00 - 13:45: Pulled riser until multibowl at drill floor. Installed big c-plate and landed off riser.
13:45 - 14:00: B/o multibowl RT. Installed false rotary.
14:00 - 14:15: Parked aft PRS w/ multibowl RT in safe position.
14:15 - 14:45: Pulled and r/b innser string.
14:45 - 15:00: R/b cutting BHA
15:00 - 15:30: P/u and m/u multibowl RT
15:30 - 16:30: Pulled tensioner joint cleaned riser for marine growth at centralizer deck. Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
16:30 - 16:45: R/u cutting machine
16:45 - 17:45: Cut tensioner joint significant wave height 2,7 m.
17:45 - 18:00: R/d cutting machine
18:00 - 18:30: L/o tensioner joint
18:30 - 19:00: Removed running tool. Installed cradle on HTS frame. Removed elevator. Cleared drill floor.

R/u cutting machine

R/d cutting machine
L/o tensioner joint
Removed running tool. Installed cradle on HTS frame. Removed elevator. Cleared drill floor.
Performed TBT for cut and pull riser joints
Lifted riser and removed master bushing.
Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck big amounts of growth on spash zone joint).
Pulled riser flange to drill floor. Installed master bushing and elevator. Removed fairing and landed riser onto elevator.
R/u cutting machine
Cut riser joint. Knifes jammed several times possibly due to movement. Changed 1 knife due to wear. Significant wave height between 2,8 and 3,3 m.
R/d cutting machine.
L/o riser joint
Pulled riser installed elevator and master bushing. Landed riser onto elevator.
R/u cutting machine. Cut riser. R/d cutting machine. Significant wave height 3,5 m.

Pulled riser out of splash zone
